original: １年には４つの季節、春、夏、秋、冬がある。

en.text: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, fall and winter.
There are four seasons in a year - spring, summer, fall, and winter.

indices: 一年{１年} には 四つ{４つ} の 季節 春[01] 夏(なつ) 秋(あき) 冬 が[01] 有る{ある}

original: 冬のまっただなかの21ヶ月前に始まったことはこの秋の夜に終わったはずがない。

en.text: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night.

original: 21カ月前、真冬の最中に始まったものを、この秋の夜に終らせるわけにはいかない。私たちが求めていた変化は、ただこの勝利だけではありません。この勝利はただ、求めていた変化を実現させるための、そのチャンスを得たに過ぎないのです。そして以前と同じようなやり方に戻ってしまったら、変化の実現などあり得ない。

en.text: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

original: 秋には山全体が紅葉する。

en.text: In autumn all the leaves on the mountain change color.
The entire mountain changes color in autumn.

original: 秋は月がきれいだ。

en.text: The moon is pretty in the fall.
The moon is beautiful in fall.

original: 一年の間には四つの季節があります。春、夏、秋、そして冬です。

en.text: There are four seasons in a year - spring, summer, fall, and winter.

original: 私たちは去年の秋に、ニューヨークへ引っ越しました。

en.text: We moved to New York last fall.

original: 昨日の夜、庭でコオロギが鳴いていたよ。秋が近付いてきてるんだね。

en.text: Last night I heard a cricket chirping in the garden. Autumn is approaching, isn't it?

original: 秋には葉っぱが黄色く色づく。

en.text: In autumn the leaves turn yellow.

original: 木々の葉は秋には黄色く色づく。

en.text: The leaves of the trees turn yellow in fall.

original: ある花は春に咲き、またある花は秋に咲く。

en.text: Some flowers bloom in spring and others in autumn.
Some flowers bloom in the spring and other flowers bloom in the fall.

original: 秋の前に夏が来た。

en.text: Before Autumn came Summer.

original: 行く秋を惜しむ気持でいっぱいだ。

en.text: The passing autumn fills me with a feeling of grief.

original: 葉は秋に黄色くなる。

en.text: Leaves yellow in the fall.

original: 春と秋ではどっちが好き？

en.text: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?
Which do you like better, spring or fall?
Which do you like better, spring or autumn?

original: 秋じゃないみたいだな。

en.text: It doesn't seem like it's autumn.

original: 秋が一番好きなんだ。

en.text: I like autumn best.

original: 秋になると紅葉します。

en.text: The leaves turn red in the fall.

original: 今年は秋が遅いね。

en.text: Fall is late this year.

original: 今年は秋の訪れが遅いわね。

en.text: Fall is late this year.

original: 風に乗ってどこからともなく金木犀の香りがした。秋を感じた瞬間だった。

en.text: You could smell the fragrant olives as they rode the wind aimlessly. In that moment it felt like autumn.

original: 秋の夜空を彩る「サプライズ花火」は、私たちに笑顔を届けてくれました。

en.text: The surprise fireworks colouring the autumn sky brought smiles to our faces.

original: 秋には、たくさんの鳥が南下します。

en.text: Many birds head south in autumn.
In the fall, many birds head for the south.

original: 秋らしくなってきたね。

en.text: It seems like autumn has come.
It seems like autumn has arrived.
It seems like it has reached autumn.
It seems like it became autumn.
Looks like autumn is here.
Looks like it's autumn.
It seems to have become autumn.
It seems to be autumn.

original: 秋の夜空に「サプライズ花火」が打ち上げられた。

en.text: Some "surprise fireworks" were launched into the autumn night sky.

original: 秋の味覚が店頭に並ぶ季節となりました。

en.text: It was the time of year when the tastes of autumn were lined up in the storefront.
It was the season when the tastes of autumn were lined up in the storefront.
It was the time of year when the flavours of autumn were lined up in the storefront.
It was the season when the flavours of autumn were lined up in the storefront.

original: 日本の秋の味覚といえば、皆さんは何を思い浮かべますか？ 私は何といっても秋刀魚です。

en.text: When you think of fall delicacies in Japan, what comes to mind? To me, it's mackerel pike.

original: 秋ですね。

en.text: Autumn is here.

original: 春と秋、どっちが好き？

en.text: Do you like Spring or Autumn more?
Do you like spring or autumn more?

original: 秋は涼しいです。

en.text: Autumn is cool.
Fall is cool.

original: 秋も近いね。そろそろ涼しくなってくる頃だよ。

en.text: Autumn is just around the corner. It's about time the weather started cooling off.

original: 秋の気配がします。

en.text: It feels like fall.

original: 秋は、10月からです。

en.text: Fall begins in October.
Autumn begins in October.

original: トムと僕は、来年の秋にオーストラリアに行く計画をしてるんだ。

en.text: Tom and I are planning on going to Australia next fall.

original: フランスが秋の時、ウルグアイは春です。

en.text: When it's fall in France, it's spring in Uruguay.

original: 秋は、食べ物がとりわけ美味しい季節です。

en.text: Autumn is when food is especially delicious.

original: 秋が好きです。

en.text: I like autumn.

original: １年には４つの季節、春、夏、秋、冬があります。

en.text: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

original: 夏が終わると、秋が来ます。

en.text: Summer ends and autumn comes.
When summer ends, autumn comes.
Autumn comes after summer.
